violations.description: COLD AND HOT STORAGE EQUIPMENT (4 pts): Cold holding unit in the facility being used for cold holding temp of 41 degrees F or less was not functioning adequately. Reach-in cooler in front prep area noted at 45?F. A re-inspeciton of this cooler will occur on or before 11-19-26. If the cooler cannot be repaired before this date the health inspector must be contacted to request a delay in inspection.
HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): A hand drying device was noted not provided at the hand washing lavatory in the front prep area. Paper towels replaced to correct the violation. . .
POISONS/TOXIC MATERIALS AND MEDICINE (3 pts): Chemical spray bottles noted not labeled in the dish washing area. Bottle were labeled with a permanent marker to correct the violation on the spot.
FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (2 pts): Can opener noted not properly cleaned/maintained.
HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): A hand drying device was noted not provided at the hand washing lavatory in the bar. Paper towels were replaced to correct the violation.

FLOORS WALLS CEILINGS (1 pts): Walls in the kitchen noted with screw and nail holes in need of caulking. Floors in the warewashing area noted in need of cleaning/mopping. Noted very wet and with some food particles under the dish washing area.
NON FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (1 pts): Front and top of the cooler containing drawers and located under the griddle noted not clean.
